title: Report a run ended input
description: The runtime finished a Running run with an outcome. When the runtime fails after the run started, the daemon issues this command with the outcome `runtime-failure` and, just before, writes the run event `runbook.runtime-failed` (record: reason) as a RecordRunEvent of its own. When the last program of the run's tree failed (it ended with an exit other than 0, was killed at its timeout or ended with no exit status, or Loom refused it for an exit its `exits.error` lists or a signal, an agent node (`sdc-node`) or any other program) and the tree has no other action to take, the daemon issues it with the outcome `failed: step <action> <end>` (`<end>`: `exit <n>`, `signal <n>`, `timed out after <s> s` or `ended with no exit`) and, just before, writes the run event `runbook.step-failed` (record: case, action, end, exit, signal and timeout_seconds (each of the last three when it applies), reason).

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome
sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.description: Open text: the outcome name of the runbook's protocol for the root case, or one of the daemon's own causes (`orphaned`, `runtime-failure`, `stopped: route`, `failed: step <action> <end>`). The run's state is the closed set; the outcome is not.
